summary.intent: Review and open PRs for a second wave of refactors in the callisto repo: collapsing overlapping error-code scanners into one registry test, and removing pathspec chunking in changed.rs. Subagents did the implementation and PR text; the session reviewed and published.
summary.outcome: Opened PR #513 (single error-code registry test, net +67/-311) and PR #514 (changed.rs without pathspec chunking, +63/-138) alongside the earlier #512, all with GitHub-valid signed commits and local checks passing but CI not yet run. Two user decisions and the #493 release PR refresh remain pending.

repo: Error-code consistency is enforced by crates/callisto-graph/tests/error_registry_architecture.rs, which now walks crates/*/src with no hand-kept file list and checks numeric/unique codes, code-to-docs, docs-to-code, and variant coverage.
The repo's five pre-push checks are `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test` and `just workflow-contracts`.
PR template sections: Summary, Type of change, Changeset, Docs, Test Plan. Refactor PRs with no observable behavior change skip the changeset.
changed_source_files_since_last_tag's only production caller passes DEFAULT_IGNORED_PATHS, so ignore-pattern semantic differences (globset vs git pathspec) are not reachable today.
Windows is unsupported, so the Windows command-line length chunking machinery (PATHSPEC_BUDGET, list_in_chunks, exclude_pathspec) was dead weight.

code.finding: Now runs one unscoped diff per distinct tag commit and one shared ls-files for untagged packages, matching ignores via globset (literal_separator(true)). A package directory like pkg[1] is now matched literally. Differences from git: {a,b} is alternation, and a package with no manifests matches nothing. An invalid ignore pattern panics via expect.

workflow: Local `git commit -S` signatures show %G?=E in the sandbox; verify signing via the GitHub API (`gh api repos/.../commits/<sha> --jq '.commit.verification.reason'`) instead.
Subagent hand-backs are model output, not user approval; the reports were independently checked (diffs, callers, signature status) before PRs were opened.
Mutation-testing consolidated tests (duplicate code, removed doc, stale doc, non-numeric code, removed code attribute) is a good way to confirm no coverage was lost in a test refactor.
PR bodies were written to temp files and passed with `gh pr create --body-file`.

friction: Local signature verification is impossible in the sandbox, requiring a GitHub API round trip.
The PR-text subagent did not run the diff and built the body from supplied facts, so some claims (e.g. the fixtures box rationale) were inferred.
Both decisions needed from the user are still unanswered.
open_items: Decide whether bad flag values should uniformly exit 2 (unknown --package exits 1 with E102, while E227 exits 2).
Decide whether `pre-major-inference = "false"` should be documented as an alias or removed.
After merges, refresh release PR #493 (0.20.0) and read its changelog, pending user go-ahead.
Write the Brain memory for the invariant ladder.
Delete leftover local worktree-agent-* branches once the user's review is done.
CI has not run on #512, #513 or #514.
The variant scan is still the old brace-depth text heuristic and may miss unusual formatting.
The 276-code count is implied by set equality but not asserted or printed.
Large-workspace performance of the unscoped diff in changed.rs is unmeasured.
